summary: Flutter app with hierarchical location selection (Country → State → District → MP → MLA → Mandal → Village) featuring scrollable dropdowns with search/filter functionality
architectural_notes: Hierarchical location selection: Country → State → District → MP Constituency → MLA Constituency → Mandal → Village
Dropdowns with 60-70% screen height max, vertical scroll, and search/filter capability
Performance optimization required for large datasets without UI freezing
known_issues: State dropdown not fully scrollable when list exceeds screen height
UI overlap preventing selection of all states
Z-index or overflow issues blocking clicks in dropdowns
Missing search/filter functionality in State dropdown

existing_features.title: Make the State dropdown fully scrollable with smooth vertical scrolling when the list exceeds screen height. Apply max-height of 60-70% of screen height to the dropdown list container.
Add search/filter functionality inside the State dropdown for better UX. Users should be able to type to filter the list of states in real-time.

Ensure cascading location selection behavior works correctly: When Country = India, load all Indian states; when State is selected, load districts under that state; when District is selected, load MP constituencies; when MP is selected, load MLA constituencies; then Mandal, then Village.
Apply the same scroll behavior (smooth vertical scroll, max-height 60-70% of screen, search/filter functionality) to all location dropdowns: State, District, MP, MLA, Mandal, and Village.
Ensure mobile-responsive and touch-friendly scrolling for all location dropdowns. Fix any z-index or overflow CSS issues that prevent clicks or selections.
Optimize dropdown rendering performance to prevent UI freezing when loading and displaying large datasets (hundreds of states, districts, etc.) on Android devices.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement scrollable location dropdowns with max-height and search/filter
Ensure mobile-responsive touch-friendly scrolling and fix z-index/overflow issues
